scope.purpose: External FMO hard-negative, duplicate, and leakage gate for the current acquisition candidates. The gate asks whether each source-admissible external FMO candidate is a genuinely new evidence row or only duplicate/supporting evidence already covered by current canonical/proposed rows.

catalytic_activity.reaction: cyclohexanone + NADPH + O2 + H(+) = hexano-6-lactone + NADP(+) + H2O
hypotaurine + NADPH + O2 + H(+) = taurine + NADP(+) + H2O
hypotaurine + NADH + O2 + H(+) = taurine + NAD(+) + H2O
trimethylamine + NADPH + O2 = trimethylamine N-oxide + NADP(+) + H2O
N,N-dimethylaniline + NADPH + O2 + H(+) = N,N-dimethylaniline N-oxide + NADP(+) + H2O
L-kynurenine + NADPH + O2 + H(+) = 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine + NADP(+) + H2O
salicylate + NADH + O2 + 2 H(+) = catechol + CO2 + NAD(+) + H2O

decision_summary.bottom_line: CHMO, HAPMO, and human FMO1 separate from the hard-negative panel and are not duplicates of the four current canonical/proposed FMO rows, but they remain source-only review leads. OTEMO is held by prior structural duplicate/leakage evidence, KMO is held by prior duplicate/leakage to m_csa:131, and salicylate hydroxylase is held as same-family aromatic hydroxylase support already covered by m_csa:131 and m_csa:551.

global_hard_negative_panel.ordinary_flavin_hydride_transfer_dehydro: Require reduced-flavin O2 activation and substrate oxygen insertion; FAD/FMN plus NAD(P)H is not sufficient.
global_hard_negative_panel.flavin_oxidase_o2_acceptor_not_monooxyge: O2 as terminal electron acceptor or peroxide generator is not sufficient; O2-derived oxygen must enter substrate.
global_hard_negative_panel.flavin_fe_s_relay_hcar_like: Fe-S/flavin electron relay is a negative unless the flavin active site forms an oxygenating peroxyflavin species.
global_hard_negative_panel.flavodiiron_no_reductase: FMN electron donation to a diiron NO-reducing site rejects as FMO.
global_hard_negative_panel.radical_flavin_fe_s_dehydratase: FAD semiquinone radical or Fe-S dehydration chemistry rejects as FMO.
global_hard_negative_panel.covalent_fad_adduct_chemistry: Covalent FAD-substrate adduct chemistry is not C4a-peroxy oxygen insertion.
global_hard_negative_panel.heme_p450_peroxidase: Heme-centered oxygen activation routes away from FMO.
global_hard_negative_panel.nonflavin_oxygenase: Pterin, non-heme iron, copper, diiron, ATP/luciferyl-adenylate, and name-only oxygenase hits reject or hold without flavin peroxy evidence.

hard_negative_separation.ordinary_flavin_hydride_transfer_dehydro: separates; NADPH reduces FAD to activate O2 and the product is a lactone from oxygen insertion, not a simple substrate redox pair.
hard_negative_separation.flavin_oxidase_o2_acceptor_not_monooxyge: separates; O2 is incorporated through Baeyer-Villiger oxygen insertion rather than used only as terminal acceptor.
hard_negative_separation.flavin_fe_s_relay: separates; UniProt cofactor is FAD with no Fe-S relay evidence.
hard_negative_separation.flavodiiron_no_reductase: separates; no diiron NO reduction evidence.

hard_negative_separation.covalent_fad_adduct: separates; BVMO peroxyflavin/Criegee chemistry is not covalent FAD-substrate adduct reduction.
hard_negative_separation.nonflavin_oxygenase_or_name_only: separates; source support includes FAD, NADPH, Rhea reaction, and reported FAD-4a-OOH transient intermediate, not name-only monooxygenase text.

candidates.expected_generic_flavin_overabsorption_f: A learned model or geometry scorer may key on the Rossmann-like FAD/NADPH fold and generic redox residues, top-ranking flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase unless the Baeyer-Villiger lactone product and FAD-4a-OOH/peroxyflavin oxygen-transfer step are encoded as required evidence.

non_claims: This gate does not edit labels, registries, ontology files, thresholds, production scoring, model outputs, or imports.
No external UniProt candidate is import-ready or countable from this artifact.

Hard_negative_gate_pass means the candidate separates chemically from the hard-negative panel and is not duplicate of the four current FMO rows; it does not mean source-free structural duplicate clearance has been established.
Duplicate_hold candidates may still be true FMO chemistry; the hold prevents duplicate/leakage or same-family evidence from inflating support.
The v2 or primary FMO promotion state is unchanged; n>=6, source-free geometry, duplicate/leakage, terminal review, and human/import gates remain required.
exact_next_action: Stop after this gate artifact. If FMO acquisition resumes later, materialize and source-free geometry/duplicate-screen the hard_negative_gate_pass rows in priority order without importing or relabeling.
